segments.name: IT related service
products: Technological support and maintenance service and other services
segments.description: Provides cloud-based IT solutions, customized CRM and ERP systems, applications and AI-OCR services to business customers in Hong Kong.
segments.evidence: Since the nature, the business processes and the marketing channel of the services are substantially similar, the Company are considered as operating in a single reportable segment with revenues derived from multiple revenue streams.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the operating subsidiaries for customized system development, application development, AI-OCR, NFT-related work and ongoing maintenance services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company are mainly engaged in the business of providing IT related service to customers.
